req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-022 requires HTTP 422 when firstName is empty string in POST /players/. The violation was test[5] (whitespace-only firstName) having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule is that negative kind must not use EP heuristic. Fixed by changing heuristic from EP to NEG for that test, which is the correct heuristic for a negative test targeting an invalid input partition. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201
preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded rows
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid payload where firstName is a non-empty string
expected: Response body contains firstName matching the submitted value
Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-022: valid firstName must be accepted (positive EP partition)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "lastName": "TestSurname",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Anjali"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestSurname"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36

test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_firstname_status_not_201_not_200
preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded rows
Squad number 95 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with firstName set to empty string
Assert that the response is NOT 200 and NOT 201
expected: HTTP 422 exactly — not 200, not 201, not 400, not 500
trace: R-PLAYER-022: confirms the exact error code 422 is returned, killing mutations that change 422 to 400 or 200
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_firstname_status_not_201_not_200():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "",
        "lastName": "Khan",
        "squadNumber": 95,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert r.status_code == 422

test_post_player_empty_firstname_status_not_201_not_200()

tests.name: test_post_player_whitespace_firstname_returns_422
preconditions: Database is loaded with 26 pre-seeded rows
Squad number 94 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with firstName set to a whitespace-only string '   '
expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity — whitespace-only is semantically empty and must be rejected
trace: R-PLAYER-022: whitespace-only firstName is in the invalid equivalence partition; must yield 422 (NEG: catches strip/trim mutations)
